answer: Three leasing companies pass lease equity (the amount our offer exceeds the lease buyout) straight to the customer: Summit Auto Lease, Crescent Motor Credit and Apex Lease Co. Bluewater Leasing doesn't pay it out but applies it to the car the customer buys from Northwind. Harbor Leasing and Ironwood Lease don't allow third-party buyouts at all, so there's no equity question with them. Two things to keep in mind: Crescent has only allowed third-party buyouts since February 1, 2026, and since that same date Apex adds a $350 third-party buyout fee to the buyout amount.
